prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A moody, cinematic scene featuring a vintage CRT television as the central subject, positioned on a dark surface in a dimly lit room. The TV screen displays classic vertical color bars in vivid hues—yellow, cyan, green, magenta, red, and blue—casting a soft, multicolored glow. The surrounding environment is bathed in deep red ambient lighting, creating a nostalgic, almost surreal atmosphere. To the left of the TV, several large, hardcover books with bold, serif titles in gold and red are stacked upright, their spines partially visible and adding a touch of intellectual character. On the right, the blurred silhouette of a round object, possibly a speaker or reel, hints at retro audio equipment. The composition is tight and intimate, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the TV and the immediate foreground, while the background fades into a warm, diffuse blur. The overall style evokes a sense of retro-futurism and analog nostalgia, reminiscent of 1980s interiors, with a color palette dominated by rich reds, deep shadows, and the bright, saturated colors of the TV test pattern. The camera angle is eye-level, straight-on, emphasizing the symmetry and iconic presence of the television in the scene.
